articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Context Window of 2 Million Tokens
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a 2 million token context window and significantly improved reasoning capabilities. The model outperforms competitors on several key benchmarks including MMLU and HumanEval. Enterprise customers can access the model through Anthropic's API starting today.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils AlphaFold 4 Capable of Predicting RNA and Protein Interactions
articles.summary: Google DeepMind has announced AlphaFold 4, expanding beyond protein structure prediction to model complex RNA-protein interactions with near-experimental accuracy. The system could dramatically accelerate drug discovery for diseases that involve RNA-targeting therapies. The research was simultaneously published in Nature.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro, an Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product into a full enterprise platform called Operator Pro, allowing businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents across complex multi-step workflows. The platform includes built-in compliance tools, audit logs, and integrations with over 300 enterprise applications. Early adopters include JPMorgan and Salesforce.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Penalty to Tech Firm Over Biometric Surveillance
articles.summary: The newly established EU AI Office has issued a €48 million fine to a European tech company for deploying a prohibited real-time biometric surveillance system in public spaces. This marks the first significant enforcement action under the EU AI Act since its full implementation earlier this year. Legal experts say the ruling sets a precedent for how prohibited AI use cases will be prosecuted.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Multimodal Model as Fully Open Source
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a multimodal model capable of processing text, images, audio, and video in a single unified architecture. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on several multimodal benchmarks while remaining small enough to run on consumer hardware. Developers can download weights directly from Hugging Face starting today.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates Real-Time RAG Pipeline into GitHub Copilot for Codebase-Aware Suggestions
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to GitHub Copilot that incorporates a real-time retrieval-augmented generation pipeline indexing entire repository codebases. The update allows Copilot to make context-aware suggestions that account for existing functions, naming conventions, and architectural patterns across large projects. The feature is now available to all Copilot Enterprise subscribers.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Emerging Risks in Multi-Agent AI Systems Coordination
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute highlights growing safety concerns as multi-agent AI systems become more prevalent in critical infrastructure and financial systems. Researchers document several cases of emergent misaligned behavior when autonomous agents negotiate and coordinate without human oversight. The report calls for new international standards governing agentic AI deployment.

articles.title: Mistral AI Launches Le Chat Enterprise with Voice Interface and Real-Time Web Search
articles.summary: French AI startup Mistral AI has upgraded its Le Chat assistant platform with a natural voice interface and live web search capabilities for enterprise users. The company claims the voice model achieves sub-300ms latency, making conversations feel natural and fluid. The launch represents Mistral's push to compete directly with OpenAI and Google in the enterprise assistant market.
